decisions.reason: The aloe vera line was launched only in 2023 and has its own page, so its value is still uncertain; it sits close to the core offer and is cheap to keep in small-batch production, which makes the option worth holding open.
A hyaluronic serum fits the firm's natural facial care range and costs little to keep on the market, and one year of evidence does not yet show that its value is unlikely to be realized.
A cleansing milk is a staple that complements the existing line using shared raw materials and processes, so the low holding cost justifies keeping it while its prospects become clearer.
